# Agentic HW Monitor 1.7.1 · build 34

GPU tuning and supported Palit lighting now share one card permission. Open **Settings › GPU control** to update the system components and authorize the selected card. Both workers require build 34. The coordinator rechecks the card identity after boot and retries temporary device failures every 15 seconds.

- **GPU recovery.** The worker checks the permission generation before handling requests. If a reset fails after a permission change, the 85 °C temperature guard can still restore automatic fans on the card it changed.
- **Lighting.** Hold repeats the saved Off setting while the app owns it. The review panel shows the observed and saved lighting and asks for a visual check. Restoring a saved setting is tied to the displayed attempt, including when two windows are open.
- **Migration.** Revoking old permissions works when GPU tuning and lighting were bound to different cards. An unresolved lighting journal retains its card identity for later recovery or archival. Settings report each worker’s availability separately.

Verification used isolated system files, simulated hardware and a simulated service manager. Physical lighting, the thermal guard on real hardware and a cold boot under systemd still need verification. The desktop package targets Ubuntu 26.04 amd64 with GTK 4.22 or later and glibc 2.39 or later.
